flow.name: invoice-send-order-items
flow.doc:description: Aggregator client: splits an order on POST /eip/invoices/orders and sends each item to POST /eip/invoices/items over HTTP, returning each item's status and the invoice.

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log order to invoice
logger.message: #['Send items of orderId=' ++ (payload.orderId default 'none') ++ ' to the invoice aggregator, correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.orderId) or (not (payload.items is Array)) or isEmpty(payload.items)]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Missing order items
raise-error.description: orderId and a non-empty items array are required

http:request.doc:name: POST Item To Invoice Aggregator
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { orderId: vars.vOrder.orderId, itemCount: sizeOf(vars.vOrder.items), sku: payload.sku, quantity: payload.quantity, unitPrice: payload.unitPrice }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: vars.vOrder.orderId, itemStatuses: vars.vItemStatuses, invoice: if (vars.vItemStatuses[-1] == 201) vars.vLastItemResponse else null }
